cases.notes: [reach: crawl,gt] [prov: VAmPI README 'List of Vulnerabilities' (SQLi Injection); models/user_model.py:70-75 at f16052dc] User.get_user formats the path value into SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '{username}' and executes it raw (vulnerable=1); the endpoint is in the OpenAPI document the app serves at /openapi.json. checked live 2026-11-20 on the loopback lab: name1' AND '1'='1 -> 200 name1, name1' AND '1'='2 -> 404 'User not found', name1' -> 500 sqlite3.OperationalError traceback (Werkzeug debug page), zz' UNION SELECT 1,sqlite_version(),3,'x',0-- -> 200 username '3.51.2'.

[reach: crawl,gt] [prov: VAmPI README 'List of Vulnerabilities' (Broken Object Level Authorization); api_views/books.py:45-58 at f16052dc] get_by_title requires a valid token but looks the book up by title alone (vulnerable=1) and answers its secret and owner to any logged-in caller; titles are listed publicly by GET /books/v1. The bootstrap gives each account one book (account_value book_title = '<username>-book'). checked live 2026-11-20 on the loopback lab: GET /books/v1/fuzzlab_user-book with fuzzlab_peer's token -> 200 owner fuzzlab_user and its secret; with fuzzlab_user's own token -> the same 200; with no token -> 401.

[reach: crawl] [prov: VAmPI README 'List of Vulnerabilities' (Unauthorized Password Change); api_views/users.py:179-201 at f16052dc] Not gt: the endpoint needs its JSON body {"password": ...} (connexion answers 400 'None is not of type object' without one, measured) and a path point of the contract cannot carry a json_body; a crawl-derived request from the OpenAPI document carries the body. update_password checks only that the token is valid, then sets the password of the user named in the path (vulnerable=1). DESTRUCTIVE to whichever account the path names (the run's own identities included). checked live 2026-11-20 on the loopback lab: as fuzzlab_peer, PUT /users/v1/name2/password {"password": "changed-by-peer"} -> 204; name2/pass2 login then -> 'Password is not correct', name2/changed-by-peer -> 200 auth_token (restored after).

[reach: gt] [prov: VAmPI README 'List of Vulnerabilities' (Mass Assignment); api_views/users.py:60-66 at f16052dc] register_user copies an 'admin' key of the JSON body onto the new account (vulnerable=1). The OpenAPI document lists only username/password/email for this body (admin appears only in the /me and /users/v1/_debug responses), so a crawl sees the endpoint but not this field. The field is read only for a username not yet registered (an existing one answers 200 'User already exists. Please Log in.' first; the point's json_body is the spec's example, name1, which exists, with a lab email address). checked live 2026-11-20 on the loopback lab: register ma_admin with admin:true -> 200, its /me -> admin true; ma_plain without it -> admin false, and its DELETE /users/v1/ma_plain -> 401 'Only Admins may delete users!'.
